name: LOD Ground Truth Generation from Surface Intersections
definition: Constructs a Level-of-Detail (LOD) representation for a scene by downsampling high-resolution binary voxels and SDFs, extracting surface intersections along axes, and storing them in a sparse pointer/data structure per grid cell.
summary: LOD Ground Truth Generation from Surface Intersections constructs Level-of-Detail representations by downsampling voxel grids and extracting surface intersections into sparse structures, distinguishing itself through this intersection-based approach.
